title: Place value and rounding
status: draft: written by Claude, waiting for owner review

hints.whole.place-value.digits: Count places from the right: ones, tens, hundreds, thousands, ten thousands. The digit is worth that many.
hints.whole.place-value.round: Look at the digit just to the right of the place you're rounding to: 5 or more rounds up, less than 5 rounds down.
hints.whole.place-value: A digit is worth its place (ones, tens, hundreds, …). To round, look one place to the right: 5 or more rounds up.

misconceptionMessages.whole.place-value-digit: That's the digit. What is it worth in its place? A 6 in the thousands place is worth 6,000.
misconceptionMessages.whole.place-value-off-by-one: Count the places again from the right: ones, tens, hundreds, thousands, …
misconceptionMessages.whole.place-value-count-zeros: Each place is worth 10 times the place to its right. Two places to the left is 10 × 10 = 100 times as much.
misconceptionMessages.whole.round-truncate: Check the digit to the right of the rounding place. 5 or more means round up, not just change the rest to zeros.
misconceptionMessages.whole.round-wrong-way: Look at the digit just to the right of the rounding place: 5 or more rounds up, less than 5 rounds down.
misconceptionMessages.whole.round-wrong-place: Read which place to round to again, and find that place in the number.

sections.title: The value of a digit
sections.objective: Find what a digit is worth.
explain: Our numbers use ten digits. Where a digit sits tells you what it's worth. Moving one place left makes it worth 10 times as much.
sections.key: A digit is worth its place: the 6 in 46,382 is in the thousands place, so it's worth 6,000.

worked.math: 46,382: the 6 is in the thousands place

sections.title: Round whole numbers
sections.objective: Round to the nearest ten, hundred or thousand.
explain: Rounding finds the nearest "easy" number. 4,762 is between 4,700 and 4,800: which is it closer to?
sections.key: Look one place to the right of the rounding place. 5 or more: round up. Less than 5: round down. Everything after becomes 0.

sections.title: Putting it together
explain: Now the questions are mixed. Find the place first.
sections.key: A digit is worth its place. To round, look one place to the right: 5 or more rounds up.
